title: The food-borne carcinogenic 2-amino-1-methyl-6-phenylimidazo[4,5-b]pyridine (PhIP) disrupts circadian rhythms and ameliorated by pterostilbene (PSB) in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Chang, Chun-Han; Yen, Pei-Ling; Pan, Min-Hsiung; Liao, Vivian Hsiu-Chuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究食物致癌物PhIP对线虫昼夜节律的干扰及紫檀芪的缓解作用，涉及DAF-16分子对接，但核心是毒理学与节律表型，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The food-borne 2-amino-1-methyl-6-phenylimidazo[4,5-b]pyridine (PhIP) is a potential human carcinogen abundant in cooked meat. While circadian rhythms are crucial biological oscillations, the negative impact of PhIP on circadian systems and the potential of mitigation remain underexplored. We investigated the effects of PhIP on circadian rhythms and the mitigating effects of the phytochemical antioxidant pterostilbene (PSB) in Caenorhabditis elegans. We show that exposure to 10 muM PhIP disrupts the 24-h circadian rhythms of C. elegans, an effect mitigated by co-exposure to 100 muM PSB. In addition, PhIP-induced circadian disruption can be linked to defective oxidative stress resistance, which is associated with the DAF-16/FOXO pathway and is modulated by PSB. Molecular docking suggested that PhIP and PSB bind similarly to DAF-16. Moreover, 10 muM PhIP abolished the rhythmic expression of the core clock gene prdx-2, which is restored by 100 muM PSB. Findings from this study provide novel insight of how food-borne contaminant like PhIP may contribute to the disruption of circadian rhythms and suggest potential for PSB to mitigate these effects in higher organisms.
abstract_zh: 食源性2-氨基-1-甲基-6-苯基咪唑并[4,5-b]吡啶（PhIP）是熟肉中含量丰富的一种潜在人类致癌物。尽管昼夜节律是关键的生物振荡，但PhIP对昼夜节律系统的负面影响及其缓解潜力仍未得到充分探索。我们研究了PhIP对秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）昼夜节律的影响，以及植物化学抗氧化剂紫檀芪（pterostilbene, PSB）的缓解作用。我们证明，暴露于10 μM PhIP会扰乱线虫的24小时昼夜节律，而同时暴露于100 μM PSB可缓解此效应。此外，PhIP诱导的昼夜节律紊乱与抗氧化应激能力缺陷相关，这涉及DAF-16/FOXO通路，并受PSB调节。分子对接提示PhIP和PSB与DAF-16的结合方式相似。而且，10 μM PhIP消除了核心时钟基因prdx-2的节律性表达，而100 μM PSB可恢复该表达。本研究结果为食源性污染物如PhIP可能如何导致昼夜节律紊乱提供了新见解，并提示PSB在高等生物中缓解这些效应的潜在可能性。
